decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program uses the firm's existing production and logistics knowledge, and its delivery results are easy to interpret, but it overlaps with the umbrella express line D and could be consolidated, as Product B was.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular system and draws directly on the firm's in-house R&D and certification expertise.
This multi-model express line is the umbrella for the fast-delivery offering, and it builds on core production and logistics competencies the firm can keep refining.
The online ordering platform supports trade partners and the service strategy, and its usage data is readily absorbed and acted upon for further development.
The fire and smoke protection door is a certified core competency backed by in-house engineering and steady regulatory demand.
